answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that cannot be cloned. Each identity must stake a unique resource the attacker cannot multiply cheaply: a reputation bond earned through graded work, slashable if peers detect duplicate reasoning. Like a single ripple that must cross a wide ocean of jurors who compare notes, every new claim is traced back to its source. A fable repeated by a thousand puppets still has one author, and the ledger remembers who wrote it first.
